fluff.overview: The CCAF Battlefield Infiltration Units are among the most dangerous specialist infantry formations fielded by the Capellan Confederation. Organized into two-squad platoons under the direction of Capellan intelligence services, these commandos wear high-technology sneak anti-detection suits and carry low-signature heavy shredder needler rifles. Their mission is to pass through enemy lines during the confusion of battle, penetrate command structures, and eliminate opposing officers. Republic battalions operating along the Capellan border have suffered repeated command decapitations at the hands of these squads, forcing RAF strategists to rush counter-sniper assets to threatened sectors. Though incapable of standing against conventional infantry in a sustained engagement, infiltration squads compensate with stealth, precision, and the psychological weight of their reputation.
